presentation.body:
आपके पास खतरा है: Flood।
आधिकारिक संदेश: DEMO EXERCISE: Flash flood likely along the stream in Demo Ward DW-01 within 20 minutes.

official.headline: DEMO EXERCISE: Flash flood likely along the stream in Demo Ward DW-01 within 20 minutes.
official.description: DEMO EXERCISE ONLY. Heavy rainfall upstream may cause a sudden rise in water level along the stream bed in the fictional demo ward.
official.instruction: DEMO EXERCISE: Move away from the stream bed to Demo Relief Post A. Help elderly and disabled neighbours. Do not cross flowing water.
